cases.name: Only service can invoke the empty-search-path invoker RPCs or read immutable private receipts
A confirmed adjustment and its receipt commit once using the existing v1 document envelope
Owner RLS permits only the committed owner document and denies other owners/anon
A dtc_documents fault rolls back both the effect and receipt
A a2_assistant_action_receipts fault rolls back both the effect and receipt
Concurrent identical confirmations return one commit and a replay
Concurrent different confirmations from the same context require re-review of the first result
A request identifier cannot be reused for different confirmed content
Deleting the effect keeps its receipt and an old replay never recreates content
Editing an existing effect cannot be overwritten by replay
A refreshed exact adjustment reference allows a subsequent different confirmation
Observed legacy insertion, mutation or deletion invalidates a stale adjustment snapshot
Source fingerprint mismatch, unavailable/old/future snapshots cannot create an effect
An adjustment may target only the pending practice day in the server projection
Santiago dates include today/day+30 but reject yesterday/day+31 independently of SQL session timezone
Strict payload, calendar, UTF-16 length and storable-text boundaries reject malformed writes
Missing pilot admission cannot be grandfathered by either RPC
Revoked pilot admission also denies lookup/replay of a previously committed action
The same request UUID is private to each owner and produces separate effect ids
Actions preserve all seeded canonical milestones, completed days, XP and browser fixtures

context: Dated server projection; action writes serialize their consumed adjustment, without a global legacy/source fence.
